name: llm-usage-monitor
description: A Teloverge application for tracking Codex and extensible LLM token usage, API-equivalent cost, and task history locally.

viewsWelcome.contents:
Open the full local usage dashboard.
[Open Dashboard](command:llmUsageMonitor.openDashboard)

Refresh usage from your Codex session metadata.
[Import Codex History](command:llmUsageMonitor.importCodexHistory)

commands.title: LLM Usage Monitor: Import Codex History
LLM Usage Monitor: Import Usage JSON
LLM Usage Monitor: Export HTML Report

llmUsageMonitor.historyDurationDays.description: Number of days of usage history to retain.

llmUsageMonitor.codexHome.description: Optional Codex home directory. Empty uses CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex.

llmUsageMonitor.autoImport.description: Import changed Codex session metadata automatically.

llmUsageMonitor.autoImportIntervalMinute.description: How often to scan local Codex metadata when automatic import is enabled.

llmUsageMonitor.showStatusBar.description: Show today's estimated usage cost in the status bar.

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/browserLauncher.js && node --check src/dashboardServer.js && node --check src/codexImporter.js && node --check src/storage.js && node --check src/pricing.js && node --check src/report.js && node --check media/pivot.js && node --check media/timeframe.js && node --check media/main.js && node --check scripts/update-version.js
scripts.package: bun run version:auto && bunx --bun vsce package --no-dependencies --baseContentUrl https://codeberg.org/PsiForge/llm-usage-monitor/src/branch/main/ --baseImagesUrl https://codeberg.org/PsiForge/llm-usage-monitor/raw/branch/main/
